summary: RES-125: removed the correlated-physical-host-failure risk for the 3-node etcd/control-plane. Created a Hetzner SPREAD placement group (restormel-spread) and rolled all 3 nodes into it (Hetzner requires power-off to change placement group), guaranteeing no two nodes share a physical host (a single host failure now costs at most one node => etcd keeps 2/3 quorum).
